def_en: The module where you learn to build and repair computers.
example_en: He studies Assembly and Maintenance of Computers.
example_es: Estudia Montaje y mantenimiento de equipos.

def_en: The module about operating systems for one user, such as Windows.
example_en: Single-user Operating Systems teaches how to install Windows.
example_es: Sistemas operativos monopuesto enseña a instalar Windows.

def_en: The module about office programs, such as word processors and spreadsheets.
example_en: In Office Automation Applications, she learns to use spreadsheets.
example_es: En Aplicaciones ofimáticas aprende a usar hojas de cálculo.

def_en: The module about operating systems that manage users and resources in a network.
example_en: She likes Network Operating Systems because she learns a lot.
example_es: Le gustan los Sistemas operativos en red porque aprende mucho.

def_en: The module about how to build and manage networks in a building.
example_en: Local Networks is about cables, switches and routers.
example_es: Redes locales trata de cables, conmutadores y routers.

def_en: The module about protecting computers and data.
example_en: In Computer Safety, he learns to protect the system.
example_es: En Seguridad informática aprende a proteger el sistema.

def_en: The module about email, web and file servers.
example_en: Network Services is a module about email, web and file servers.
example_es: Servicios en red es un módulo sobre correo, web y servidores de archivos.

def_en: The module about creating and managing web applications.
example_en: He prefers Web Applications because it is creative.
example_es: Prefiere Aplicaciones web porque es creativa.

def_en: The module that helps students prepare their CV and job interviews.
example_en: Professional Training and Guidance helps students prepare for job interviews.
example_es: Formación y orientación laboral ayuda a los alumnos a preparar entrevistas de trabajo.

es: técnico/a de instalación y reparación de sistemas informáticos
def_en: A person who installs and repairs computer systems.
example_en: A technician in computer system installation-repair visits customers' offices.
example_es: Un técnico de instalación y reparación de sistemas informáticos visita las oficinas de los clientes.

def_en: A person who looks after the computers of a company.
example_en: The computer systems technician updates all the workstations.
example_es: El técnico de sistemas informáticos actualiza todos los puestos de trabajo.

def_en: A person who installs and repairs network cables and devices.
example_en: A data networks technician installs and repairs network cables.
example_es: Un técnico de redes de datos instala y repara cables de red.

es: reparador/a de periféricos de sistemas microinformáticos
def_en: A person who repairs printers, keyboards, and other devices.
example_en: A repairer of microcomputer systems peripherals fixes printers and scanners.
example_es: Un reparador de periféricos arregla impresoras y escáneres.

def_en: A person who sells computers and explains their prices and features.
example_en: The sales representative explains the price of each laptop.
example_es: El comercial explica el precio de cada portátil.

def_en: A person who helps customers by phone or online.
example_en: A teleassistance operator helps customers by phone.
example_es: Un operador de teleasistencia ayuda a los clientes por teléfono.

def_en: A person who controls and monitors computer systems.
example_en: The systems operator checks the servers every morning.
example_es: El operador de sistemas revisa los servidores cada mañana.

def_en: A person who solves the computer problems of users.
example_en: The helpdesk technician resets passwords.
example_es: El técnico de soporte restablece contraseñas.

def_en: A person who manages the servers and users of a company.
example_en: The system administrator installs the updates at night.
example_es: El administrador de sistemas instala las actualizaciones por la noche.

def_en: A person who creates websites and web applications.
example_en: The web developer is designing a new online shop.
example_es: El desarrollador web está diseñando una tienda en línea nueva.

def_en: A person who looks for risks and protects the systems of a company.
example_en: The security analyst found a virus on the server.
example_es: El analista de seguridad encontró un virus en el servidor.

def_en: A technician who travels to the customer's place to repair equipment.
example_en: A field technician drives to the customer's office.
example_es: Un técnico de campo conduce hasta la oficina del cliente.

def_en: The person in charge of the IT department.
example_en: The IT manager decides which computers to buy.
example_es: El responsable de informática decide qué ordenadores comprar.
